$comment: Same contract as the Action's submit_review tool (src/types.ts REVIEW_TOOL_SCHEMA). Write one object per batch to batch-N.draft.json (review) and batch-N.result.json (verification). Add "incomplete": true if you could not finish the batch; finalize then marks its files for retry.

overall_assessment.description: 2-5 sentences judging the change as a whole: name the patterns it introduces, say whether the design is sound, and end by characterising what the issues (if any) amount to.

findings.description: Line-anchored review findings. Empty if the code is clean.

path.description: Repo-relative file path, exactly as in the batch's ### heading.

line.description: Line number in the NEW file (the number printed before the diff line). Must be a + or context line shown in the diff.

end_line.description: Last line of a multi-line finding. Omit for single-line findings.

title.description: Short noun-phrase label, at most ~8 words, e.g. 'Missing `on SessionExpiredException` handler'. Not a sentence.

summary.description: One line naming the problem AND its consequence. Rendered in a markdown table cell: no newlines, no |.

body.description: 3-6 sentences, one paragraph. Name the concrete symbols, trace the failure path step by step, state the consequence. Contrast with sibling code when the issue is an inconsistency.

suggestion.description: Optional. Replacement code for lines [line..end_line], no fences. Only for mechanical fixes you are confident compile.

observations.description: Real issues in surrounding/unchanged code NOT anchored to a changed line. Never repeat a finding here.

note.description: What you noticed and why it matters. One paragraph; rendered in a table cell.

file_reviews.description: Exactly one entry for every file in this batch, including clean files and tests.

summary.description: Start with 'clean;' when the file has no surviving finding, then concrete evidence (behaviour changed, prior finding fixed, regression a test pins). Never 'looks good'.

prior_finding_verdicts.description: One verdict for every previous finding supplied in the prompt. Empty when none were supplied.

id.description: The exact opaque id from the previous-findings section.

reason.description: One sentence citing the visible evidence.
